summary: Unify every visible select into a custom accessible dropdown and lighten main/background panel overlay.
acceptance: Every visible selector uses one styled reusable dropdown, including organization switch, pagination and business forms.
Keyboard navigation/typeahead/focus/Escape and nested panel interactions work; dropdown remains visible above panels within mobile viewport.
FormData preserves raw option values, names, disabled fields, required constraints and optional empty selection; controlled/uncontrolled behavior retained.
Main content uses white background and panel backdrop is light, retaining orange accents and legible controls.
semanticRouting: UI-only control replacement and presentation; no new business capability, authorization, data/engine/API/identity changes. UX preflight, frontend implementation and independent UX/a11y/architecture dependency review plus QA acceptance.
